sharedRules.name: Makeshift Armor (131)
sharedRules.description: Increases their AV (+1) and decrease their MV (-1).

sharedRules.name: Reactive Armor (133)
sharedRules.description: (+2) AV vs SA: Ammo/Limited Ammo weapon systems. (-1) AV vs all other weapon systems.

sharedRules.name: Ablative Armor (129)
sharedRules.description: (-1) AV vs SA: Ammo/Limited Ammo weapon systems. (+2) AV vs all other weapon systems.

sharedRules.name: Ammo ( E16)
sharedRules.description: Critical Fumble (Combat Roll only) requires 1d6 roll. On a (1) result, “jam/out of ammo” for all weapon systems of that type

sharedRules.name: Ammo Bin (119):
sharedRules.description: Each ammo bin level allows a model to ignore one “out of ammo” critical fumble result as detailed by the SA: Ammo/Limited Ammo.

sharedRules.name: AoE (125)
sharedRules.description: Allows for a ranged assault or other effect to affect any model caught within the specied radius.

sharedRules.name: Full-Auto (126)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to re-roll one die from any Combat Roll result.

sharedRules.name: Hard (126)
sharedRules.description: Model is subject to any game rules that may apply to a model with the SA Hard.

sharedRules.name: Improved Chassis (122)
sharedRules.description: Allows a model to mount a weapon system up to two damage tracks heavier than it would normally be allowed to use, decreasing it’s base armor value by (-1). (Already Calculated)

sharedRules.name: Improved Range (127)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to direct-re ranged assault Combat Rolls when red from long or extreme range band.

sharedRules.name: Indirect-Fire (127)
sharedRules.description: Allows for indirect-re ranged assault with or without a valid LoS.

sharedRules.name: Limited Ammo (E16)
sharedRules.description: Critical Fumble (Combat Roll only) requires 1d6 roll. On a (1) or (2) result, “jam/out of ammo” for all weapon systems of that type.

sharedRules.name: Minimum Range (127)
sharedRules.description: Blocks use of weapon system(s) as part of a ranged assault vs model equal to or less than the stated range.

sharedRules.name: Ravage (127)
sharedRules.description: Doubles any damage to infantry models when in clear/open terrain types.

sharedRules.name: SMART (128)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to add (+1) to AoE or damage value of weapon system(s) by reducing other by (-1). Cannot be used to reduce below “0".

sharedRules.name: Shock (128)
sharedRules.description: Roll Target-Point Roll vs SA: Shock value on any successful Combat Roll hit (no damage required). Failed roll results in Model State: Suppression.

sharedRules.name: Superior Mobility (123)
sharedRules.description: (-1) MV cost when moving through rough, rubble, light woods, or elevation-based terrain objects.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Targeting Computer (119)
sharedRules.description: (+1/+2) to all direct-fire ranged assault Combat Roll(s) or Strike-Point Roll(s). Requires Target-Lock Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: Ace Pilot (129)
sharedRules.description: Add a (+2) to any die roll made by the model they have been assigned to.

sharedRules.name: Amped Weapons (P) (129)
sharedRules.description: Increase the Hard RAV of a single weapon type on a model by 1

sharedRules.name: Buffering (131)
sharedRules.description: Ignores the effects of ion disruptor cannons.

sharedRules.name: Claymore Anti-Personnel Mine (129)
sharedRules.description:
Single Use item, providing a (+2) to the models combat roll value when the equipping model is the primary attacker against a defending infantry model or, the model is the defender in a close-combat assault and any attacker is an infantry model. A model with the SA: Anti-Infantry will not receive this bonus if it is a supporting
attacker or there are no infantry models attacking it.

sharedRules.name: Close-Quarters Battle (130)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to their CCV value as a primary attacker or defender in a close-combat assault with another CAV model. This upgrade does NOT stack with the Ace or Veteran pilot Upgrade.

sharedRules.name: Cluster Munitions (136)
sharedRules.description: Used to deliver anti-tank and personnel sub-munitions (mines) to a specific target area. After determining the final strike-point of teh "attack", place a minefield template equal to the AoE of the attack to represent the area that has been "mined" by the cluster munition rockets. Cluster "mines" will go active immediately, "attacking" any model that moves into or through teh indicated template location.

sharedRules.name: Combat Engineer (130)
sharedRules.description: This upgrade is required to allow a model to deploy one or more Battlefield Assets (p. 136). A combat engineer will typically require the use of a special action and a target-point or 10+ roll, using the rating level as a (+) situation modifier to any roll.

sharedRules.name: Experimental Nano-Tech (133)
sharedRules.description: Will always receive a critical success when successfully rolling for the repair action, repairing two points of damage (non-lingering only). A critical failure repair roll will disable the system and prevent any additional repair attempts for the remainder of the game.

sharedRules.name: External Active Phase Array Pod (133)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any friendly model's primary combat roll if the targeted enemy model is currently located within its area of effect (AoE12).

sharedRules.name: External Ammo Bin (130)
sharedRules.description: Each ammo bin level allows a model to ignore one “out of ammo” critical fumble result as detailed by the SA: Ammo/Limited Ammo.

sharedRules.name: External Anti-Nano Dispersion Pod (130)
sharedRules.description: A single-use item which may used (free action) to dissipate any nano clouds that it is currently in.

sharedRules.name: External Chain-Fire Pod (130)
sharedRules.description:
Allows other models in the same squad to use a strike point that it has made a successful strike point roll to hit (no drift), provided they have not already declared a strike point attempt during the current turn. The model with the SA: Chain-Fire Pod must use the target lock action on a defending model before attempting the strike
point roll and each attacking model is still required to make a successful combat roll to damage any defending models. The model is also required to make a Special Action to upload the data to the BattkeNet, for the other models to use. A model is not required to have the SA: Chain-Fire Pod in order to “chain-in” and use the designated strike point.

sharedRules.name: External ECM Pod (130/E18)
sharedRules.description: May only be used to block the use of the target-lock action by an enemy model(s) located within its active range (AoE12).

sharedRules.name: External Fire Control Pod (131)
sharedRules.description: If there are two models in the squad with the SA: FCS, both models would receive a (+1) to any strike point rolls made by either one. Any additional models in the same squad with the SA: FCS would each add another (+1).

sharedRules.name: FIST (Fire Support Team) (131)
sharedRules.description: A FIST member will typically require the use of a special action to request immediate _re-support, using the rating level of the upgrade as a (+) situation modifier to the strike-point roll of an attack.

sharedRules.name: Fire-Supression System (131)
sharedRules.description: Extinguish any fire (free action), making it immune to the Model State: Burning.

sharedRules.name: Non-Commissioned Officer (NCO) (132/E18)
sharedRules.description: +1 to starting C3 points

sharedRules.name: Orbital Drop Strike Team (ODST) (133)
sharedRules.description: At the beginning of any turn, a card may be assigned and added to the draw deck during the shuffle. Once this assigned card is drawn, the ODST squad(s) may be deployed, no closer than 12” to an enemy model, and proceed with its activation. If no legal deployment location is available, deployment is delayed to the following turn, repeating the process. Once a squad has deployed it no longer requires an assigned card and will activate like any other squad for the remainder of the game.

sharedRules.name: Semi-Guided (136)
sharedRules.description: A model with one or more rocket launchers may upgrade their ammo to include this ammo. This allowes the model to receive a (+1) when making the strike-point roll provided the target area is currently subject to the SA: TAG. The addition of the fuidance and control section reduces the payload of each rocket, resulting in a (-1) to the weapon system's RAV.

sharedRules.name: Turbo-Charged (134)
sharedRules.description: Increases a model's base MV by (+1). (Already Calculated)

sharedRules.name: Assault (120)
sharedRules.description: Removes one Combat Roll penalty per level when using the Combat Action: Run N’ Gun. Does NOT provide Combat Roll bonus.

sharedRules.name: ECM (E15)
sharedRules.description: May use a special action to perform one of the following functions each turn: 1. Block any target-lock attempt by an enemy model currently located within its area of effect. 2. Attempt to “jam” any enemy model using the SA: Active Phase Array or SA: ECM currently located within its area of effect. 3. Receive an automatic target-lock on one model using the SA: Active Phase Array (within GM range) and use the combat action to _re one or more anti-radiation guided missiles at the enemy model, provided it has not already used a combat or target-lock action during the current turn.

sharedRules.name: EST (E16)
sharedRules.description: Will automatically share a target-lock on an enemy model with any other model from its squad.

sharedRules.name: Expanded Chassis (121)
sharedRules.description: Adds an extra hard-point to a model, decreasing it’s base armor value by (-2). (Already Calculated)

sharedRules.name: Rugged (124)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to repair x2 non-lingering damage tracks with successful Repair Action 10+ Roll.

sharedRules.name: Relentless (124)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to ignore any Critical Damage Table reduction result(s). Model will still receive three damage points.

sharedRules.name: HARM (136)
sharedRules.description: High-speed anti-radiation ammo that are designed to detect and lock-on to a "radio" emission source. Radar, jamming units, and even some high-powered radio transmitters can be targeted. Model must have APA or ECM and Guided Missile Weapon System to equip.

sharedRules.name: Officer (133/E18)
sharedRules.description: Adds a nuber of C3 points equal to the officer level noted.

sharedRules.name: Veteran Pilot (134)
sharedRules.description: Add a (+1) to any die roll made by the model they have been assigned to.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Aircraft (E14)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to use Combat Action vs NoE aircraft models. (+1/+2) to Combat Roll(s) vs aircraft models.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Infantry (119)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to all close-combat assault Combat Roll(s) vs infantry models.

sharedRules.name: Blaster (E17)
sharedRules.description: Increases the chance of a Critical Success (+1d6 to nal roll) when making a Combat Roll. Blaster (+1), Blaster 1 (+2), Blaster 2 (+3).

sharedRules.name: Blitz (126)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to all close-combat assault Combat Roll(s).

sharedRules.name: Bulky (126)
sharedRules.description: Counts as two models for the purpose of transport.

sharedRules.name: CHAMELEON (120)
sharedRules.description: (-1) to all direct-fire ranged assault Combat Roll(s) from medium range-band or greater.

sharedRules.name: Counter-Measures (120)
sharedRules.description: Allows for one attempt per turn to“block”Target-Lock Action or SA: TAG (0 AP). (+1) to 10+ Roll per rating level equipped.

sharedRules.name: Double-Time (E18)
sharedRules.description: (-2) to any Combat Roll vs equipped model if full MV used for 1 AP in single direction. Requires MV (11+).

sharedRules.name: Improved Armor (122)
sharedRules.description: Increase their armor value by (+1) and reduce their movement and damage control value by (-2).

sharedRules.name: Improved Damage Control (122)
sharedRules.description: Increases each damage control value by (+1). (Already Calculated)

sharedRules.name: Improved Handling (E17)
sharedRules.description:
Drift: Wheeled combat vehicles and quad-CAVs can “drift”, moving 1” forward and up to 1” left or right at the same time, using only 1 MV (plus any additional terrain-type costs) for the maneuver. Lateral Shift/Roll: Aircraft, quad-CAVs, hover and anti-grav combat vehicles can use a lateral shift (a roll for aircraft) to move sideways up to
1” without changing their facing, using only 1 MV (plus any additional terrain-type costs) for the maneuver. Multiple lateral shifts/rolls can be used by the model during the same move action.

sharedRules.name: Overdrive (E17)
sharedRules.description: Doubles any damage. Requires declaration before any Combat Roll(s). Roll 1d6, target-point (1), +1 per additional weapon system used. Failed result prevents weapon system(s) use one turn. Critical Fumble (Combat Roll only) disables weapon system(s) for remainder of game.

sharedRules.name: Piercing (123)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any single weapon system type a model has equipped with a Hard RAV of “0+”.

sharedRules.name: Pop-Up (E18)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to conduct a direct-fire ranged assault from some Blocking Cover terrain objects with no return fire permitted by enemy model(s).

sharedRules.name: Shielded (124)
sharedRules.description: Ignores the effects of nano-disassemblers and ion disruptor cannons.

sharedRules.name: Soft (128)
sharedRules.description: Model is considered a soft target when determining damage value track to use.

sharedRules.name: Strike (128)
sharedRules.description: Blocks use vs aircraft or infantry as part of a ranged assault Combat Action.

sharedRules.name: TAG (124)
sharedRules.description: Allows equipped model to use guided missiles and/or other laser-based weapon systems as part of a ranged assault. Does not add any (+).

sharedRules.name: Turret (E16)
sharedRules.description: Allows for unlimited firing arc and vehicles to use “hull-down”when adjacent to E1 hill terrain object. Hull-down provides for valid LoS for direct-fire ranged assaults and Heavy Cover bonus to equipped model.

sharedRules.name: Wizzo (125)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any direct-Fire ranged assault Combat Roll(s) or indirect-fire Strike-Point Roll(s).

sharedRules.name: Airborne Training (129)
sharedRules.description: May dismount a transporting aircraft at any point along its declared flight path during the activation of either the infantry or aircraft model as a free action.

sharedRules.name: Jump Pack (132)
sharedRules.description: +2 to their base MV, that can be used to make “short hops” to bypass the terrain below (Move Class: Air).

sharedRules.name: Linked (132)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any direct-fired ranged assaults.

sharedRules.name: Medic (132)
sharedRules.description: May use a (repair action) on any infantry model in the same squad they are currently in B2B contact with and recover one point of damage.

sharedRules.name: Motorized (132)
sharedRules.description: +3 to the base MV and changes the model’s move class to: wheeled, hover, or anti-grav (player’s choice).

sharedRules.name: Storm Training (134)
sharedRules.description: Use the mount or dismount action as a free action when disembarking from a ground-based transport.

sharedRules.name: Active Phased Array (118)
sharedRules.description: (+1/+2) to all direct-fire ranged assault Combat Roll(s) or Strike Roll(s). Requires enemy model in range (24”/30”). Allows Jamming Action. Requires Special Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: FCS (121)
sharedRules.description: For each additional model with the SA: FCS in a squad, a (+1) is added to each model's Strike-Point Roll.

sharedRules.name: Gun Port (122)
sharedRules.description: Allows one mounted infantry model to perform one direct-fire ranged assault during activation per rating level equipped.

sharedRules.name: Improved Breeder (122)
sharedRules.description: Increases a model's base MV by (+2). (Already Calculated)

sharedRules.name: Amped Weapons (S) (129)
sharedRules.description: Increase the Soft RAV of a single weapon type on a model by 1

sharedRules.name: Specialist (128)
sharedRules.description: Model can only be used as part of a Specialist Squad.

sharedRules.name: Unique (128)
sharedRules.description: Allows only one model of this type or description as part of a valid Force Group.

sharedRules.name: Large Sensor Profile (122)
sharedRules.description: A model with this SA provides a (+1) to the primary combat or strike-point roll of any enemy model attacking the model with a ranged assault.

sharedRules.name: AEGIS (119)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to close-combat assault Combat Roll(s) when defending.

sharedRules.name: Airborne (119)
sharedRules.description: May dismount a transporting aircraft at any point along its declared flight path during the activation of either the infantry or aircraft model as a free action.

sharedRules.name: Amphibious (119)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to“cross” non-allowed water-based terrain objects. Requires additional (+1) MV per inch moved.

sharedRules.name: Chain-Fire Pod (120)
sharedRules.description: Allows other models in same squad to use equipped model’s final Strike-Point location. Requires Target-Lock Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: Counter-Battery (120/E15)
sharedRules.description: Allows for indirect-fire ranged assault (no Strike-Point Roll required) vs enemy model with a final Strike-Point Location 12” or less from equipped model. Requires 1 AP and available Combat Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: Fire-Proof (121)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to ignore Model State: Burning. Additional rating level allows model to remove state within 3” from any other model or terrain object. Requires Special Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: Grenadier (122)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any close-combat assault Combat Roll. Available to infantry models only.

sharedRules.name: Launcher (122)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to serve as deployment point for (1+) cruise missile(s) per rating level.

sharedRules.name: Point Defense (123/E16)
sharedRules.description: A successful +10 Roll, when useing this SA, will shoot-down any incoming guided missile, mortar, or rocket tranged-attack from a single attacker, preventing ANY Combat Roll for that weapon system(s) once per turn.

sharedRules.name: Rat (123)
sharedRules.description: Allows infantry models Light Cover vs any ranged assault Combat Roll(s). Blocks SA: Ravage.

sharedRules.name: Reduced Turn (123)
sharedRules.description: This SA removes the free facing change a non-infantry model receives when using the move action. Any facing changed requires the model to spend 1 MV to perform.

sharedRules.name: Reinforced (123)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to reduce any Combat Roll Damage Table MoS by equipped rating level. Cannot be used to reduce below“0.”

sharedRules.name: Re-Supply (124)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to remove any “jam/out of ammo” from a friendly model it is currently B2B with. Requires Special Action to activate.

sharedRules.name: Shredder (124)
sharedRules.description: (+1) to any single weapon system type a model has equipped with a Soft RAV of “0+”.

sharedRules.name: Smoke (124)
sharedRules.description: A model with this SA is equipped with a smoke generator that can be used to disrupt targeting systems and block a TAG attempt. Using a special action to activate, a model with this SA can be used to create a smoke field in place(2" radius) or a "line" of smoke as the model moves (1" wide X 1" long) for each 1" spent moving in a straight line(any facing change ends the smoke line). The smoke will provide a light cover bonus to any model that an attacker's line of sight passes through for a direct-fired, ranged attack. The smoke will also block any TAG attempt that traces a line through it. Lasts till this Model's next activation.

sharedRules.name: Storm (124)
sharedRules.description: Allows infantry model to use Mount/Dismount Action from ground-based transport vehicles and aircraft for (0) AP.

sharedRules.name: Transport (125)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to transport one non-bulky infantry model per rating level equipped.

sharedRules.name: C3 (126)
sharedRules.description: Increases C3 point pool (+1) per rating level equipped.

sharedRules.name: Locked-On (127)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to use Target-Lock Action with no AP cost (0 AP).

sharedRules.name: Satellite Uplink (127)
sharedRules.description: Allows model to request one Strike Package: Space attack per turn (0 AP) anywhere on game board with successful Target-Point Roll (1) 1d6.

sharedRules.name: Slow-Fire (128)
sharedRules.description: Blocks indicated weapon system(s) from being used in two consecutive turns.

sharedRules.name: Grenade (E13)
sharedRules.description:
A small “bomb” that is thrown by hand and is especially useful during close-assault and for “clearing” out an enemy-occupied structure. As an exception to the rule on p. 66, infantry
equipped with grenades can be used to conduct a close-combat assault against an enemy infantry model located “inside” a structure. An attacking model must be in B2B contact with the structure and both attacking and defending models must be on the same elevation level or adjacent floors (if both models are inside the structure).

sharedRules.name: Advanced Cruise Missile (141)
sharedRules.description: See P. 141

sharedRules.name: Cruise Missile (141)
sharedRules.description: See P. 141

sharedRules.name: Loadmaster (132)
sharedRules.description: +1 to Transport level

sharedRules.name: Doctrines
sharedRules.description: If you choose to use a Force Doctrine, you must select the same Doctrine in each Squad.

sharedRules.name: Fire and Fury Warfare Doctrine
sharedRules.description: All Adonese models with the SA: Active Phase Array (APA) or SA: ECM receive an additional 6" bonus to the base range of their area of effect.

sharedRules.name: Hyrwyda Dyrnel Doctrine
sharedRules.description:
All Adonese infantry models receive the SA: Rat at no Extra Cost
All Adonese infantry models receive a +1 close-combat assault bonus vs other infantry models. This bonus will stack with the SA: Grenadier.

sharedRules.name: The Lend-Lease Doctrine
sharedRules.description: As part of an Almirithil force group, players may also select models from the Ritterlich forcelist (no SA:Unique) to include as part of their overall selection.

sharedRules.name: The Dogs of War Doctrine
sharedRules.description: An Almirithil force group may purchase, as a specialist squad, a Templar attack squad. Each Templar model will receive the Battlefield Upgrade: Veteran at no aditional TVP cost. (Add a Templar Attack Squad to your roster in place of the single Speciallist Squad you are allowed)

sharedRules.name: Superior Tactics Doctrine
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, a Ritter force group commander may select the initiative card that was just turned over and send it to the bottom of the deck.

sharedRules.name: Lightning Warfare Doctrine
sharedRules.description: Every non-infantry model will receive the SA: Assault +1 at no additional TVP cost.

sharedRules.name: Fanaticism Doctrine
sharedRules.description: The Hammer of Khardullis allows any non-infantry model to "sacrifice" itself (removed from play), regardless of it's current damage track, in an attempt to destroy an enemy model in one last desperate attack. A variant of salvo fire, a player using this attack may use any direct-fire weapon system (including guided missiles, provided an existing target-lock/TAG is available) as part of the ranged assault and will make a combat roll for Each weapon system being used. The player will designate one weapon system as the primary attack weapon, using its RAV and any SAs for the ranged assult, adding a +1 situation modifier for each additional weapon being used. When determing range, this attack uses the shortest range band from hte weapon system's being fired. Example on P 83

sharedRules.name: Conscription Doctrine
sharedRules.description: Each Malvernian infantry or mechanized infantry squad will receive two additional infantry models (of the same type) for free ( no additional TVP cost) regardless of normal squad limitations. Optional upgrades and transport must be purchased separately.

sharedRules.name: Children of the Storm Doctrine
sharedRules.description:
Non-infantry Rach models conduction a ranged assault at point-blank range receive a (+2) situation modifier to their attack instead of the normal (+1).
In addition, all non-infantry Rach models will reduce their armor values by (-1) and increase their base movement balue by (+2).

sharedRules.name: No Mercy Doctrine
sharedRules.description: Rach infantry models acting as the primary attacker in a close-combat assault will do one additional point of damage on any successful attack.

sharedRules.name: Air Superiority Doctrine
sharedRules.description:
Terran force group will receive a Forward Air Controller that may, once each turn, request a free Gunship Assault during the activation of any friendly squad for immediate deployment anywhere on the game-board surface. An attack not used by the end of a turn is lost. 
A Terran force group may purchase an additional flight squad for each primary squad taken that does not count towards the normal primary/secondary squad ratio. (Each primary squad lets you have a flight squad)

sharedRules.name: Artillery Superiority Doctrine
sharedRules.description:
A Terran force group may, once each turn, request a free Artillery Strike during the activation of any friendly dquad for immediate deploymnet anywhere on the game-board surface. An attack not used by the end of a turn is lost. 
All Terran infantry models receive the SA: FIST 1 at no extra cost.

sharedRules.name: Elite Training Doctrine
sharedRules.description: The following squad types, as part of a Templar force group, have their minimum model requirement reduced by one: Attack, Fire Support, Flight, and Recon.

sharedRules.name: Superior Equipment Doctrine
sharedRules.description: A Templar force group will receive additional specialization points, equal to 10% of their starting threat value pool, to use on any non-infantry models for the purchase of battlefield upgrades only.
